TXT_SUBTITLE: A little music. A little more focus.
TXT_YOUR_SPACE: Choose a playlist and a track to listen to.
TXT_OVERRIDE_HINT: Your playlist choice lasts until the next timer start or session change. Your saved configuration stays the same.
TXT_QUEUE_HINT: Choose, reorder, or remove tracks from your playlist without interrupting the timer.
TXT_SILENT: No playlist selected. You can still use Pomodoro without music.
TXT_EMPTY: This playlist has no playable tracks. Choose another playlist.
MSG_PLAYER_ERROR: Couldn't play music. Try again or choose another playlist.
MSG_AUTOPLAY_BLOCKED: Press the play music button to let your browser start playback.
MSG_TRACK_SKIPPED: That track couldn't play. Trying another track.
TXT_SHARED_HINT: Choose the same playlist for focus and breaks to keep music playing when sessions change.
